system.description:
With a cryptic phrase and a commanding word, you chain a wraith to a single place or object, sealing it where it cannot flee.

Engage the wraith in a Social Challenge, retesting with Occult. If you win, it cannot leave the room (or move more than 10 feet from a chosen object) for the remainder of the evening. Spending a temporary Willpower Trait at the time of the Haunting extends this to a full week; a permanent Willpower Trait extends it to a year. Should the wraith attempt to leave the bound area, it suffers one aggravated health level of damage per turn until it returns or is destroyed.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
